description_en: Associates a resource discovery with an IPAM instance
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam associate-ipam-resource-discovery --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-id ipam-ccxbnsbhew0d6t0000 --ipam-resource-discovery-id ipam-res-disco-jt5f2af2u6nk2z3210000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateIpamResourceDiscovery

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPAM instance
parameters.name: ipam_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource discovery instance
parameters.name: ipam_resource_discovery_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run. Checks parameters, syntax, and quotas and limits, with no changes being made. Returns DryRunOperation if validation succeeds; otherwise returns an error.

false (default): Sends the request. On success, returns a 2xx status and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会关联资源发现和IPAM实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并关联资源发现和IPAM实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotency. Provide a unique ASCII token generated by your client. A new token is provided for each distinct request.

If this parameter is not specified, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
